_about: Single source of truth for job-application autofill. Nothing here is compiled by a tool in this repo; it's the canonical set of facts to (a) fill your Simplify/Indeed profile once and (b) copy from when a form asks for something. Keep in sync with career-docs/cv.tex. Never add SSN, date of birth, or government ID numbers.

targets._note: May 2027 graduation is locked; used identically on every application. Internship door is closed (no returning-student status). See target-roles.md / job-search-strategy.md.

summary: CS/ML PhD candidate (Data Science, Stevens; expected May 2027) focused on multi-agent LLM systems, verifier-guided reasoning, and temporal modeling; four peer-reviewed publications including SIAM SDM 2026.

experience.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Built an end-to-end information-extraction pipeline (OCR -> spaCy NER -> rule-based post-processing) with Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, extracting structured clinical insights from 5,000+ scanned colonoscopy reports.
Boosted entity-level F1 by 28% and cut clinician manual review time by 45%; migrated the annotation workflow from Prodigy to Doccano, saving $1,700/year in licensing while preserving consistency.

experience.title: Research Assistant
bullets: Modeled symptom clusters in 144 veteran self-reports (K-means, hierarchical clustering, Gaussian-Bayesian networks) with silhouette/elbow selection and t-test validation.
Built a bilingual (Chinese/English) media-analytics pipeline over 1M+ news articles; fine-tuned BERT on HPC clusters, reaching 90% accuracy (5-fold cross-validation).
